g.text: Au-coated PMMA grating: x periodic, y invariant
P=200 nm | PMMA H=500 nm | core width=10..130 nm
Au side (x): 30 nm | cap: 30 nm x 70 nm | valley: 30 nm
300 PMMA profile layers + 1 Au cap layer = 301 finite layers
Infinite extrusion in y. TE: E along y; TM: E along x. Light enters from air above.
Drawing shows the actual midpoint staircase. Horizontal/vertical scales differ.
